description.zh:
请求长轮询的最长等待时间。取值范围\[0,60]，单位为秒。取值说明如下：
- 取值等于0：请求立即返回当前执行状态。
- 取值大于0：请求在服务端长轮询等待执行结束，最长等待设定的秒数。
description.en:
The maximum wait time for a long polling request, in seconds. Valid values: 0 to 60.

- 0: The request immediately returns the current status of the execution.

- A value greater than 0: The request waits on the server for the execution to complete. The maximum wait time is the value that you specify.

title.zh: 获取一次执行的状态信息

example.unifiedCli: aliyun fnf describe-execution --flow-name my_flow_name --execution-name my_exec_name --wait-time-seconds 20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun fnf DescribeExecution --region cn-hangzhou --ExecutionName my_exec_name --FlowName my_flow_name --WaitTimeSeconds 20
